title: 报警与事故报告程序
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/157_报警与事故报告程序.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/157_报警与事故报告程序/src.py

points.K5: 逐级报告：负责人到学校

shots.scene: 欣欣举着电话听筒
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a telephone handset, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第14章第三课：报警与事故报告程序。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边三个按钮：火、救护车、警车
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at three big buttons floating beside it with a fire truck icon, an ambulance icon and a police car icon.
shots.narration: 出了事，打给谁？怎么说？报给谁？

shots.scene: 阿杰在走廊看到隔壁门缝冒烟
shots.prompt_en: In a university building corridor, the young male student sees smoke coming from under a laboratory door.
shots.narration: 阿杰发现隔壁实验室冒烟了。

shots.scene: 阿杰慌张打电话：实验室着火了！
shots.prompt_en: The young male student shouts into his phone in panic, waving his free hand.
shots.narration: 他慌忙打电话：着火了，快来！

shots.scene: 电话那头一连串问号
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a phone with several question marks coming out of the speaker. No text.
shots.narration: 哪个学校？哪栋楼？几楼？他答不上来。

shots.scene: 小研拿着门口的信息牌，帮他说清楚
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at the information plate beside the lab door and helps him speak on the phone.
shots.narration: 小研过来，指着门牌帮他说清。

shots.scene: 发现险情，先退到安全处
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person stepping back from a smoking door to a safe spot in the corridor. No text.
shots.narration: 发现险情，先让自己处在安全位置。

shots.scene: 大声呼喊，提醒周围的人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person shouting with sound waves, nearby people turning to look. No text.
shots.narration: 大声呼喊，提醒周围的人。

shots.scene: 看到别人出事，转身就走，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person walking away from an injured colleague, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 看到别人出事，不能不管。

shots.scene: 光站着同情，也打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person just standing and staring sadly at an incident without acting, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 光同情没用，要马上报警报告。

shots.scene: 确认安全后报警、报告
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person in a safe place making a phone call, with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 确认安全，立即报警、报告负责人。

shots.scene: 国外电话号码牌打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a foreign style emergency number card crossed out, next to a card with three telephone icons. No text.
shots.narration: 国外的应急电话，在国内不适用。

shots.scene: 消防车：119
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fire truck icon with a telephone icon beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 着火、爆炸、泄漏，拨打火警119。

shots.scene: 救护车：120
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an ambulance icon with a telephone icon beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 有人受伤或不适，拨打急救120。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a police car icon with a telephone icon beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 盗抢、危险品丢失，拨打110。

shots.scene: 学校保卫处值班室
shots.prompt_en: The security officer answers a phone at a campus security duty desk with monitor screens.
shots.narration: 同时通知学校保卫处值班室。

shots.scene: 门口的应急电话卡，存进手机
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at a blank emergency contact card on a lab door and saves numbers into his phone.
shots.narration: 门口贴的应急电话，要记牢。

shots.scene: 火太大打119，能扑灭也要报告
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small fire being put out with an extinguisher, then an arrow to a phone call to the supervisor. No text.
shots.narration: 火控制不住打119；扑灭了也要报告。

shots.scene: 电话旁四个图标：地点、情况、伤员、危险物
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a phone in the center with four icons around it, a map pin, a flame, a person count and a hazard diamond. No text.
shots.narration: 打电话，先说清地点。

shots.scene: 【实拍】实验室门口的安全信息牌（楼号房间号、负责人电话）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a blank laboratory door information plate with a room number area and a contact area.
shots.narration: 学校、校区、楼号、楼层、房间号。

shots.scene: 发生了什么：着火、泄漏、受伤
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a speech bubble with icons of a flame, a leaking bottle and an injured person. No text.
shots.narration: 再说发生了什么，火多大。

shots.scene: 几人受伤，伤情如何
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a speech bubble with two person icons, one lying down. No text.
shots.narration: 几个人受伤，伤得怎么样。

shots.scene: 有什么危险物：化学品、气瓶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a speech bubble with a chemical bottle, a gas cylinder and a hazard symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 现场有没有化学品、气瓶等危险物。

shots.scene: 留下电话，不先挂机
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a phone showing an ongoing call and a hand not pressing the end button. No text.
shots.narration: 留下电话，等对方问完再挂。

shots.scene: 派人到楼门口接应消防车
shots.prompt_en: The young male student waves at an arriving fire truck at the building entrance and leads the way.
shots.narration: 派人到楼门口接应，引导救援。

shots.scene: 救护人员到场，小研递上化学品瓶和说明书
shots.prompt_en: Paramedics arrive and the female graduate student hands them a reagent bottle label and a safety data sheet.
shots.narration: 告诉救援人员，是什么化学品。

shots.scene: 说明书急救部分
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a safety data sheet with the first aid section highlighted and a doctor icon. No text.
shots.narration: 就医时带上安全技术说明书。

shots.scene: 没有说明书，带上标签照片
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a phone taking a photo of a chemical label, then the photo shown to a doctor. No text.
shots.narration: 来不及就带标签或拍照。

shots.scene: 接触了生物材料，告诉医生
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person telling a doctor about a culture tube with a biohazard warning sign. No text.
shots.narration: 接触了生物材料，也要告诉医生。

shots.scene: 沾到皮肤眼睛，先冲洗再送医
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an eye being rinsed at an eyewash station, then an arrow to an ambulance. No text.
shots.narration: 沾到皮肤眼睛，先冲洗，再送医。

shots.section_title: 逐级报告：负责人到学校
shots.scene: 报告链条：实验室负责人→学院→学校
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a reporting chain of three steps with arrows, a lab leader icon, a college building and a campus building. No text.
shots.narration: 报警的同时，按程序逐级报告。
overlay: 逐级报告：负责人到学校

shots.section_title: 逐级报告：负责人到学校
shots.scene: 阿杰第一时间打给老周
shots.prompt_en: The young male student calls the older man on his phone right away.
shots.narration: 第一时间报告实验室负责人。

shots.section_title: 逐级报告：负责人到学校
shots.scene: 老周报告学院，王老师接电话
shots.prompt_en: The older man calls the safety administrator, who answers at her office desk.
shots.narration: 负责人报告学院和保卫处。

shots.section_title: 逐级报告：负责人到学校
shots.scene: 学院报告学校管理部门
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a college building sending an arrow to a campus office with a lab safety management icon and a security icon. No text.
shots.narration: 学院再报学校实验室管理部门。

shots.section_title: 逐级报告：负责人到学校
shots.scene: 生物、辐射事故还要报专门部门
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: biohazard and radiation warning signs each with an arrow to a special committee icon. No text.
shots.narration: 生物、辐射事故，还要报专门部门。

shots.section_title: 逐级报告：负责人到学校
shots.scene: 学校按规定报告上级主管部门
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a campus building sending an arrow up to a government building icon. No text.
shots.narration: 需要时，由学校报告主管部门。

shots.section_title: 逐级报告：负责人到学校
shots.scene: 实习和外出时，报告指导老师和保卫处
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: students outdoors on a field trip calling a teacher and a campus security icon. No text.
shots.narration: 外出实习出事，报指导老师和保卫处。

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员接到电话
shots.prompt_en: The security officer receives a call, writes on a blank log and picks up a radio.
shots.narration: 保卫处接到报告，马上行动。

shots.scene: 保卫处联系消防、医院、公安
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a campus security icon connected by arrows to fire, ambulance and police icons. No text.
shots.narration: 联系消防、急救，协调救援力量。

shots.scene: 保卫处人员到场警戒
shots.prompt_en: The security officer sets up a barrier tape at a corridor and keeps people away.
shots.narration: 派人到场，警戒、疏散、引导。

shots.scene: 校门口打开通道，引导车辆
shots.prompt_en: The security officer opens the campus gate and waves an arriving ambulance through.
shots.narration: 打开校门通道，带消防车急救车进来。

shots.scene: 时钟和报告单
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clock with an urgent arrow next to a blank report form. No text.
shots.narration: 事故要及时报告，不能拖。

shots.scene: 层层上报的楼梯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a staircase of report arrows going up level by level, each with a timer icon. No text.
shots.narration: 严重事故，在规定时限内层层上报。

shots.scene: 迟报、漏报、瞒报三个打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three report forms, one late with a clock, one missing, one hidden in a drawer, all crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不迟报、不漏报、不瞒报、不谎报。

shots.scene: 小事故也报告
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small cut finger and a small spill, each with an arrow to a report form. No text.
shots.narration: 小事故、未遂事件，也要报告。

shots.scene: 王老师：时限程序以本校规定为准
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a blank rules folder on her desk.
shots.narration: 时限和程序，以本校规定为准。

shots.scene: 触电、起火、跳闸冒烟都要报告
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of an electric shock, a small fire and a smoking breaker panel, each with a report arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 触电、起火、跳闸冒烟，都要报告。

shots.scene: 警戒带围住现场，不乱动
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lab bench area surrounded by barrier tape, a hand reaching to tidy up crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 救人之外，保护现场，不乱动。

shots.scene: 拍照记录现场
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes photos of the scene from outside the barrier tape.
shots.narration: 需要移动的，先拍照、做标记。

shots.scene: 如实写下时间、经过、处理
shots.prompt_en: The young male student writes a blank incident record at a desk, recalling the events.
shots.narration: 如实记录时间、经过和处理情况。

shots.scene: 配合调查，找原因防再犯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an investigation magnifier over a record, then an arrow to a fixed hazard with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 配合查明原因，防止再犯。

shots.scene: 三个电话图标和保卫处
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: fire truck, ambulance and police icons with phones, plus a campus security icon. No text.

shots.scene: 电话旁四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a phone with a map pin, a flame, a person count and a hazard diamond around it. No text.
shots.narration: 说清地点、情况、伤员、危险物。

shots.scene: 报告链条打勾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the reporting chain from lab leader to college to campus with check marks. No text.
shots.narration: 逐级报告，及时如实，保护现场。

shots.scene: 欣欣打开一个急救箱
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot opens a first aid kit and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：急救基础与常见外伤。
